semantics.omitted_on_create: Not supplied or not yet known; never implicitly approved or complete.
semantics.omitted_on_update: Preserve prior value, including other stories and common commentary.
semantics.empty_array: An explicit clear only on an editable collection where an empty value is allowed; absence does not clear.
semantics.null: Rejected; not shorthand for omission or deletion.
semantics.stable_identity: Story key remains US-001; criterion IDs remain stable for the same obligation. Reordering does not renumber. Semantic replacement/retirement follows factory rules.
semantics.nested_objects: update_item changes recursively preserve omitted object members; supplied arrays replace that collection explicitly. Use item operations for individual criterion/task edits.
semantics.atomicity: Apply on a copy, validate the complete merged draft and references, compare revision, then retain a full new snapshot atomically. Published/frozen obligations remain immutable.
semantics.outcome: incomplete describes the overall Plan. Finishing one enrichment turn does not make the Plan completed.
semantics.human_review: Authenticated owner feedback and review authority remain factory-bound; agents do not write approved flags.
semantics.example_omission: Comment and reason intentionally remain as authored at revision 1; focused updates do not regenerate prose automatically.
